plan.task: Frozen-spectrum soft-background return-branch diagnostic; no new complete model fit
plan.inverse: One-dimensional monotone inversion of the fixed negative-polarity log-current table, scaled only by original_Ron/common_Ron. Use full existing table support, no extension. Verify used inverse points against fixed spectral quadrature without refitting.
plan.fraction_scope: 0.5 and 0.9 are explicit hypothetical lower bounds on background fraction for sensitivity only, not measured confidence bands. At 1.0 the inverse is the effective pure-soft equality; for unknown nonnegative parallel path it is only an upper bound on Gamma.
plan.static_diagnostic: Compute per-record and pooled maximum uniformly guaranteed background fraction compatible with one static Gamma and nonnegative path; do not fit a static Gamma.
plan.monotone_diagnostic: Use cumulative minima of effective Gamma upper bounds to test existence of nonincreasing Gamma along return and calculate the greatest compatible lower background fraction.
plan.minimal_dynamics_screen: Only derive feasible beta intervals for d ln Gamma/ds = -beta*abs(V), beta>=0, s in path volts. On return D=0.5*(2.5^2-v^2). Apply pairwise interval inequalities; no beta scan or optimization. Initial Gamma is allowed inside observed apex intervals only as a necessary-condition relaxation, never as a predictive initialization.
plan.tail_gate: Invert only the original aggregate return 0.2 V feature interval, with additive-path versus pure-soft meanings kept separate.
plan.budget_start: After input loading, hash checks, source/plan manifest and selected array extraction; includes inversion, diagnostics, and direct spectral evaluation.
forbidden: initializing a forward model from its own return tail
inferring seconds or temperature from voltage steps

collective_static.note: The tail gate is an across-record median acceptance interval, not a per-record confidence interval. Its lower Gamma endpoint applies only if soft current supplies that tail, not merely a>=0.

previous_frozen_background.note: This alone permits lowering a static Gamma; it does not establish the need for a new dynamical state.

numerical_check.scope: Direct evaluation at table inverse points checks numerical error, not spectral adequacy or experimental uncertainty. Fractions/interval screens use the fixed table and are conditional, not confidence tests.

next_kinetic_budget.law: d ln Gamma/ds=-beta*abs(Vh), beta>=0; s in path volts, no seconds inferred
next_kinetic_budget.pure_soft_required_budget: beta*D(v)=ln[Gamma_eff(M)/Gamma_eff(v)] only under zero path contribution and exact fixed spectrum.
next_kinetic_budget.interval_budget: L_i <= ln Gamma(M)-beta*D_i <= U_i. For every j<i: (L_j-U_i)/(D_i-D_j) <= beta <= (U_j-L_i)/(D_i-D_j). Intersect all pairs, records and beta>=0.
next_kinetic_budget.initial_state: Gamma(M) must ultimately follow the same material dynamics from earlier history. Measured apex intervals are used only to relax the necessary screen; no tail value initializes a prediction.
next_kinetic_budget.nonnegative_path_only: With no positive lower bound on background share, the six observations yield no nontrivial lower Gamma or decay-rate bound. Static sufficiently small Gamma remains allowed.
next_kinetic_budget.interpretation: Failure of beta intervals can come from fixed spectral shape, assumed background share, state dynamics, or unknown protocol. It does not uniquely select a microscopic mechanism.
